title: alchemilla vulgaris subsp. mairei
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. mairei, commonly known as the lady's mantle, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include soothing and calming effects on the digestive system, reducing inflammation, and aiding in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. mairei are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which have been identified as the primary active compounds in the plant.
